name: Marguerite & Magnolia
source: Fae sisters with a strong love for nature, Marguerite as well as her sister Magnolia are gifted in the healing arts as well as the forces of nature. Marguerite is active and jovial, while Magnolia is more reserved. Being Fae anthros, the two are affected by the magical mystery more than most.
